_note: Cross-platform vectors for pullWatermark.ts <-> PullWatermark.swift (pull checkpoint, 2026-10-07). A watermark is a Firestore server `_syncedAt` instant as { seconds, nanoseconds } (exact - no float rounding). nextPullWatermark(prev, syncedAts) is the max of prev and every non-null syncedAt in the batch; null/absent entries (a doc with no _syncedAt yet, e.g. a pending server timestamp) never move it; an all-null batch with no prev stays null. The checkpoint never moves backwards. Resume queries use >= the stored value, so same-instant siblings of the last applied doc are re-read (the echo guard makes them free).

cases.name: empty batch with no prev stays null
all-null batch with no prev stays null
first checkpoint is the batch max
